summary: End-to-end backend + frontend tested. 19/20 pytest passed (1 flaky parallel race). Full UI flow verified: public screens, scoreboard reactivity, R1 result toggle, admin PIN login, Bios/Pairings visibility, logout.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: harden parallel leaderboard tests (not a backend defect).

Storage key cached in module global; fine for single worker.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded 12 players + 12 matches; cleaned all results after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use PIN 1926. BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. WS at /api/ws broadcasts match_updated. Tests clean up results after each case.
rca_of_issue: TestLeaderboardLogic::test_leader_switches intermittently fails under pytest-xdist because another worker's TestMatchResults writes an NZ_WIN into the shared DB between clear_all and assert. Not a backend bug; serialize tests or run with -p no:xdist to avoid.
